nodes.name: adversarial-evaluator.ts
nodes.summary: Two-stage adversarial brief evaluation pipeline (critic + synthesizer LLM passes) with niche-aware VPS thresholds and client memory loading; persists evaluation rounds for audit.

nodes.name: getNicheThresholds
nodes.summary: Resolves per-niche VPS pass/fail thresholds for the adversarial evaluator.

nodes.name: loadClientMemory
nodes.summary: Loads cached client memory snapshot used to ground the critic and synthesizer prompts.

nodes.name: runCritic
nodes.summary: Runs the LLM critic pass that scores and challenges a draft brief against niche thresholds and prior memory.

nodes.name: runSynthesizer
nodes.summary: Runs the LLM synthesizer pass that revises the brief in response to critic findings.

nodes.name: adversarialEvaluateBrief
nodes.summary: Top-level orchestrator that loops critic and synthesizer rounds until the brief converges or hits the round limit.

nodes.name: storeEvaluationRounds
nodes.summary: Persists every critic/synthesizer round to Supabase for downstream auditing and learning.

nodes.name: calendar-refresh.ts
nodes.summary: Cron-style job that finds active content calendars and refreshes upcoming briefs against latest creator context and pattern metrics.

nodes.name: refreshActiveCalendars
nodes.summary: Iterates active users with content calendars and triggers a per-user refresh, aggregating outcomes.

nodes.name: refreshCalendarForUser
nodes.summary: Refreshes a single user's content calendar by recomputing pattern adjusted scores and rebuilding upcoming briefs.

nodes.name: content-calendar.ts
nodes.summary: Generates a diverse content calendar of brief proposals by combining pattern performance signals, creator preferences, and LLM brief drafting.

nodes.name: generateContentCalendar
nodes.summary: Builds a multi-day content calendar by ranking patterns, selecting diverse picks, and generating LLM-backed brief content for each slot.

nodes.name: buildPerformanceMap
nodes.summary: Builds a pattern-id keyed map of historical performance metrics used to weight calendar candidate scoring.

nodes.name: computeAdjustedScore
nodes.summary: Adjusts a pattern's base score using historical performance, recency, and creator preference signals.

nodes.name: selectDiversePatterns
nodes.summary: Picks a diversified set of patterns for the calendar avoiding repeats of the same hook or format clusters.

nodes.name: generateBriefContent
nodes.summary: Calls the LLM to draft hook, beats, and CTA for a single calendar slot brief grounded in creator context.

nodes.name: parseBriefResponse
nodes.summary: Parses and validates the LLM brief response into the structured brief shape used downstream.

nodes.name: suggestFormat
nodes.summary: Suggests a content format string for a brief based on niche, prior performance, and pattern hints.

nodes.name: buildFallbackHook
nodes.summary: Constructs a deterministic fallback hook line when the LLM brief generation fails or omits a hook.

nodes.name: pattern-performance-tracker.ts
nodes.summary: Records realized VPS and engagement outcomes against the pattern/brief that produced them so the calendar engine can learn over time.

nodes.name: trackPatternPerformance
nodes.summary: Writes per-pattern realized performance metrics (VPS, views, retention) for use by the calendar's adjusted score.

nodes.name: variant-generator.ts
nodes.summary: Generates alternative hook/format/CTA variants for an existing brief and persists/selects between them.

nodes.name: inferHookType
nodes.summary: Classifies a hook string into one of the known hook types using keyword heuristics.

nodes.name: inferFormat
nodes.summary: Classifies a brief into a content format bucket from its structure and hook style.

nodes.name: generateVariantBrief
nodes.summary: Generates a single alternative brief variant by swapping hook type or format and rewriting via the LLM.

nodes.name: generateBriefVariants
nodes.summary: Generates a fan-out of brief variants for a given base brief and returns them ranked.

nodes.name: storeVariants
nodes.summary: Persists generated variants to Supabase keyed by the originating brief id.

nodes.name: selectVariant
nodes.summary: Marks a specific variant as selected and updates the parent brief reference.

nodes.name: getVariantsForBriefs
nodes.summary: Batch-loads all stored variants for a set of brief ids.

nodes.name: AudioVisualContext.tsx
nodes.summary: Thin React context bundling audio and visual cross-cutting state for the studio surface.

nodes.name: AudioVisualProvider
nodes.summary: Provider component composing audio/visual sub-state and exposing it to descendants.

nodes.name: AnimationContext.tsx
nodes.summary: Tiny React context wrapping global animation settings (reduced-motion, durations) for the app.

nodes.name: AudioContext.tsx
nodes.summary: Large React context managing TikTok sound state: library browsing, selection, playback, and trend metadata.

nodes.name: AudioProvider
nodes.summary: Provider implementing the entire audio state machine for the studio (selection, playback, trending sound queries).

nodes.name: AuthContext.tsx
nodes.summary: React context wrapping Supabase auth state, session refresh, and login/logout actions for the whole app.

nodes.name: AuthProvider
nodes.summary: Provider that subscribes to Supabase auth state changes and exposes user, session, and auth actions to the tree.

nodes.name: ComponentIntegrationContext.tsx
nodes.summary: Coordinates cross-component integration state (selection, focus, side-panel routing) between editor surfaces.

nodes.name: ComponentIntegrationProvider
nodes.summary: Provider that synchronizes selected component, side-panel and navigation hooks for cross-pane integration.

nodes.name: DeepgramContext.tsx
nodes.summary: React context wrapping a Deepgram live-transcription socket: key fetch, connection lifecycle, and event re-exports.

nodes.name: DeepgramContextProvider
nodes.summary: Provider that opens and manages a Deepgram live-transcription socket and exposes transcript events.

nodes.name: EditorContext.tsx
nodes.summary: Primary editor state container: template, UI state, undo/redo history, and section-level actions for the studio editor.

nodes.name: createDefaultTemplate
nodes.summary: Builds the default empty template the editor uses when no content has been loaded.

nodes.name: createInitialUIState
nodes.summary: Returns the default UI state (active tool, panels, zoom) for a freshly-opened editor.

nodes.name: createInitialEditorState
nodes.summary: Composes the initial editor state by combining default template and UI state.

nodes.name: EditorProvider
nodes.summary: Provider implementing the full editor reducer, undo/redo, section mutations, and side effects.

nodes.name: FeatureContext.tsx
nodes.summary: React context exposing remote feature flags loaded from Firebase, with helper hook for individual flags.

nodes.name: FeatureProvider
nodes.summary: Provider that loads feature flag config from Firebase and keeps it in sync for descendants.

nodes.name: MLSuggestionsContext.tsx
nodes.summary: Manages AI-driven editor suggestion fetching, accept/reject state, and UI surfacing for ML-suggested template edits.

nodes.name: suggestionsReducer
nodes.summary: Reducer handling add/remove/accept/reject events for the ML suggestion list.

nodes.name: uiStateReducer
nodes.summary: Reducer handling panel-open, focused suggestion, and loading flags for the suggestions UI.

nodes.name: MLSuggestionsProvider
nodes.summary: Provider wiring the suggestion service to the editor: fetches suggestions when state changes and exposes accept/reject handlers.

nodes.name: NavigationContext.tsx
nodes.summary: Centralizes app navigation: breadcrumbs, transition state, deep links, and a PageTransition wrapper component.

nodes.name: NavigationProvider
nodes.summary: Provider tracking current route, breadcrumbs, and transitions; exposes navigation actions to descendants.

nodes.name: PageTransition
nodes.summary: Wrapper component that drives in/out animations around route changes using the navigation context.

nodes.name: StateContext.tsx
nodes.summary: Minimal generic state context used as a lightweight cross-component store for the studio shell.

nodes.name: SubscriptionContext.tsx
nodes.summary: Loads the user's subscription tier and entitlement flags and exposes them for plan-gated UI.

nodes.name: SubscriptionProvider
nodes.summary: Provider that fetches the active user's subscription record and exposes plan, limits, and entitlement helpers.

nodes.name: TemplateEditorContext.tsx
nodes.summary: Comprehensive template editor state: reducer-driven section/element mutations, history, and selection for the template authoring surface.

nodes.name: createDefaultTemplate
nodes.summary: Creates the default empty template used to seed the template editor.

nodes.name: createInitialUIState
nodes.summary: Returns the initial UI state (selected ids, zoom, side-panels) for the template editor.

nodes.name: createInitialEditorState
nodes.summary: Composes the full initial editor state from template, UI state, and an empty history entry.

nodes.name: editorReducer
nodes.summary: Central reducer handling every section/element mutation, undo/redo, and selection event for the template editor.

nodes.name: TemplateEditorProvider
nodes.summary: Provider that wires the editor reducer with persistence, autosave, and exposes action helpers to descendants.

nodes.name: ThemeContext.tsx
nodes.summary: Theme provider wrapping next-themes with a local hook plus light/dark toggle for the app shell.

nodes.name: UsabilityTestContext.tsx
nodes.summary: Runs in-app usability test sessions: assigns scenarios, captures task results, and persists session telemetry.

nodes.name: UsabilityTestProvider
nodes.summary: Provider that runs an active usability test session, tracking tasks, timing, and emitting telemetry events.

nodes.name: assemble-context.ts
nodes.summary: Assembles a token-budgeted runtime context for AI calls by fetching hot/warm memory, skill config, cultural events, accuracy stats, and agency niches.

nodes.name: fetchHotMemory
nodes.summary: Loads the most-recent hot-tier memory records to prepend to AI prompts.

nodes.name: fetchWarmMemory
nodes.summary: Loads warm-tier memory (older, condensed summaries) used when hot memory is insufficient.

nodes.name: fetchSkillSetConfig
nodes.summary: Loads the active skill-set configuration that controls which prompts and tools are wired into the runtime context.

nodes.name: fetchCulturalEvents
nodes.summary: Loads upcoming cultural events relevant to the agency niche set for context grounding.

nodes.name: fetchAccuracyStats
nodes.summary: Loads recent prediction accuracy stats per niche for the context preamble.

nodes.name: fetchAgencyNiches
nodes.summary: Loads the niches associated with the active agency to scope downstream queries.

nodes.name: trimMemoryToBudget
nodes.summary: Trims merged memory records down to fit within the configured token budget for the prompt.

nodes.name: assembleContext
nodes.summary: Top-level orchestrator that fetches every context source in parallel, applies the token budget, and returns the final assembled context.

nodes.name: emptyContext
nodes.summary: Returns an empty default context shape used when the user has no agency or memory configured.

nodes.name: logContextAssembly
nodes.summary: Persists a context-assembly log row capturing source sizes and token totals for observability.

nodes.name: component-status-checker.ts
nodes.summary: Health-check engine for the operations control center: pulls per-component prediction stats, pings the Python service, and rolls everything into status summaries.

nodes.name: getComponentStatsFromDatabase
nodes.summary: Queries Supabase for recent per-component run stats (success rate, latency, last-run) used by the dashboard.

nodes.name: checkPythonService
nodes.summary: Pings the Python XGBoost prediction service and returns reachability and version info.

nodes.name: formatTimeAgo
nodes.summary: Formats a timestamp as a human-friendly relative duration for the dashboard.

nodes.name: checkAllComponentsHealth
nodes.summary: Fans out per-component checks against the registry and aggregates their stats and statuses.

nodes.name: checkEnhancementsStatus
nodes.summary: Inspects whether prediction enhancements (e.g. Pack V, calibration) are active and returns badges for the dashboard.

nodes.name: getComponentCountByStatus
nodes.summary: Tallies components grouped by health status for the dashboard summary cards.

nodes.name: getComponentSummaryStats
nodes.summary: Computes summary stats (active count, failure count, average latency) across all components for the dashboard header.

nodes.name: constants.ts
nodes.summary: Declarative registry of pages, components, and thresholds rendered by the operations control center dashboard.

nodes.name: page-health-checker.ts
nodes.summary: Runs workflow- and route-level health checks for the operations control center page status grid.

nodes.name: checkWorkflowHealth
nodes.summary: Checks a single workflow's recent run status to derive a health verdict.

nodes.name: checkAllPagesHealth
nodes.summary: Iterates every registered control-center page and aggregates per-page health status.

nodes.name: checkPageHealth
nodes.summary: Runs the workflow checks bound to a single dashboard page and returns its status verdict.

nodes.name: types.ts
nodes.summary: Type definitions for control-center pages, components, statuses, and aggregate stats consumed by the dashboard.
